verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document an interactive API reference or explorer with runnable examples for Adyen Risk Management. The GitHub OpenAPI repo only recommends importing the API definition into Postman, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. The OpenAPI probe paths on docs.adyen.com all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
